metadata.title: Bojro | Built in Bangla for Bangladesh
metadata.description: A Bangla-first shopping experience for Bangladesh, built on trust, speed, and care.

hero.description: A new shopping experience made for Bangladesh, where quality, clarity, and care shape every step.
hero.benefitAuthentic: A commitment to verified, 100% authentic products
hero.benefitCod: Simple cash on delivery across Bangladesh
hero.benefitDelivery: Fast delivery with clear order updates

trust.title: Shopping that feels clear, easy, and quick
trust.description: Familiar language, effortless navigation, and confidence on every screen shape the Bojro experience.
trust.authenticDescription: Quality and source verification will always come before everything else.
trust.codDescription: A familiar, straightforward payment experience designed for your comfort.
trust.deliveryDescription: Clear updates planned from confirmation through final delivery.
trust.returnDescription: No runaround when something goes wrong—just clear, human support.

footer.label: Site footer
footer.description: A Bangla-first shopping experience for Bangladesh, built with trust, speed, and care.
footer.newsletterDescription: Be first to hear about new stories and member benefits.
footer.newsletterUnavailable: Subscriptions will be available when the newsletter launches.
footer.socialUnavailable: This link will be added soon
footer.madeFor: Made with care for the people of Bangladesh.

categories.title: Shop by category
categories.description: Find the right product faster through Bojro's carefully organized collections.

search.title: Search Bojro

purchase.addError: Could not add this item. Please try again.

delivery.title: Delivery estimate
delivery.error: The estimate is unavailable right now. Try another district or retry shortly.

reviews.title: Customer reviews
reviews.emptyDescription: Verified buyers will be able to share their experience here.

questions.title: Questions & answers
questions.emptyDescription: Product questions and store answers will appear here when the Q&A service launches.

related.title: You may also like
related.description: More authentic picks selected from the same part of our catalog.

cart.metaDescription: Review your Bojro cart, offers, delivery estimate, and server-verified total.
cart.title: Your cart
cart.subtitle: Every price, offer, and delivery fee is verified before checkout.
cart.actionError: That cart update could not be completed. Please try again.
cart.secureNote: Your final total is always recalculated securely by Bojro.

empty.title: Your cart is ready for something good
empty.description: Explore the collection and add a product when you find the right one.

line.unavailable: The requested quantity is no longer available.

warnings.itemUnavailable: An item is no longer available and must be removed.
warnings.insufficientStock: An item quantity is higher than current stock.
warnings.couponIneligible: The selected offer no longer applies to this cart.

checkout.metaDescription: Place a server-verified cash-on-delivery order with Bojro.
checkout.title: Checkout with confidence
checkout.subtitle: Guest checkout is welcome. We verify stock, offers, delivery, and the final total before creating your order.

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.description: Add at least one product before starting checkout.

account.title: Checkout preference
account.guest: Continue as a guest, or sign in to use your verified account.

address.title: Delivery address
address.linePlaceholder: House, road, area, and a nearby landmark
address.error: Locations could not load. Check your connection and try again.

payment.title: Payment method
payment.codDescription: Pay in cash when your order arrives.
payment.onlyCod: Cash on delivery is the available payment method for this checkout.

review.title: Order review
review.editNotice: Editing any field will require a fresh verified total.

validation.addressLength: Enter at least 5 characters for the address.
validation.notesLength: Notes must be 500 characters or fewer.
validation.invalid: Review this field and choose a valid value.

conflict.title: We need you to review one detail
conflict.stock: Stock changed before the order could be placed. Review your cart and verify the total again.
conflict.quote: Prices or delivery details changed. Verify the latest total before placing the order.
conflict.codRisk: Cash on delivery is not available for this number. No order was created.
conflict.authRequired: This phone belongs to an existing Bojro account. Sign in with a phone code before placing the order.
conflict.generic: Checkout could not be completed. Review the details and try again.
conflict.unknown: The connection ended before Bojro could confirm the result. Retry without editing to safely use the same order reference.
conflict.quoteExpired: The verified total expired. Verify the latest total before placing the order.
conflict.retryQuote: Review the form, then verify the total again.

checkout.secure: Your idempotency key protects network retries from creating a duplicate order. Prices and stock are never trusted from the browser.

auth.metaDescription: Sign in to Bojro securely with a phone OTP or your existing email and password.
auth.title: Your Bojro account
auth.subtitle: Use a phone code for a quick sign-in, or use the email and password already linked to your account.

signedIn.title: You are signed in
signedIn.description: Your current session is active on this device.
signedIn.cartAdjusted: Your guest cart was merged with this account. One or more quantities were adjusted to current stock.

available.title: What is available here
available.description: This page currently supports secure sign-in, session details, and sign-out. Saved addresses, order history, wishlists, reviews, coupons, and support conversations are not available here yet.

otp.title: Sign in with your phone
otp.description: Enter a Bangladesh mobile number to request a one-time verification code.
otp.name: Name
otp.requestSuccess: Your code request was accepted. Check your phone and enter the code below.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.description: Use the email and password already connected to your Bojro account.

auth.security: Passwords and verification codes are sent only to the secure Bojro API. They are never saved in browser storage.
auth.genericError: This account action could not be completed. Please try again.

order.metaDescription: Your private Bojro order receipt and delivery timeline.

error.title: This receipt is not available
error.description: Use the same browser or signed-in account that placed the order, then try again.

order.title: Thank you for choosing Bojro
order.description: Your cash-on-delivery order is safely recorded. Keep the order number for delivery updates.

tracking.metaDescription: Track a Bojro order privately with its order number and delivery phone.
tracking.title: Track your order
tracking.subtitle: Enter the order number and delivery phone. Your phone stays in the secure request and never appears in the page URL.
tracking.invalidNumber: Enter an order number like BJ-2026-000123.
tracking.notFound: We could not match those details. Check both fields and try again.
tracking.genericError: Tracking is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
tracking.retryAfter: Too many tracking attempts. Try again in {seconds}s.
tracking.privacy: For privacy, the result shows only redacted contact and location details.

errors.apiDescription: Bojro's data service is temporarily unavailable. Your device is fine; retry in a moment.
errors.homeEmptyDescription: There are no visible homepage sections yet, but the catalog may still be available.
errors.unexpectedDescription: The issue has been contained. Retry the page without losing your place.
errors.shellFallback: The shell API is unavailable. Safe fallback navigation is active.

notFound.title: This page moved at lightning speed
notFound.description: The address may be outdated, or this catalog item is no longer visible.
